title: Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 mini instead of the flagship model to get similar…
content:
Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 mini instead of the flagship model to get similar quality at lower cost and faster generation speed.  
Generate multiple product color variants (e.g., five colorways of the same sneaker) in a single generation to avoid reshooting each SKU.  
Place the same product into different scenes by prompting the environment/action (e.g., wet street, neon, mid-stride) so the scene builds around the product without a location shoot.  
Use 720p output to keep costs low (starting around $0.02/sec) and enable high-volume iteration by generating many clips cheaply.
